BiblicalUsage: Jealous is also the warning Joshua gives the people and the opening of Nahum: ye cannot serve the LORD, for He is an holy God, a jealous God who will not forgive your transgressions, and God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the two warnings together as one: the jealous God is not to be served lightly.
